original_target.title: Does the disk minimize the third Dirichlet eigenvalue?

scope_comparison: Target is the third Dirichlet eigenvalue for arbitrary bounded planar open sets, allowing disconnected sets, at fixed area. Robin, Neumann, Dirac, eigenvalue-ratio and nodal-line counterexamples do not prove or disprove the requested disk-minimality inequality.
